description: Generates tailored legal document suites (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Cookie Policy, EULA, Acceptable Use, Disclaimer) assembled from modular statutory clauses grounded in EDPB, CPPA, and ICO regulator guidance.

collects_cookies.description: Whether the site uses cookies or browser local storage

collects_minors.description: Whether services are accessible to or directed at minors under 13/16

contact_email.description: Official legal and privacy contact email

has_user_accounts.description: Whether end-users can register accounts or log in

processes_payments.description: Whether the site processes payments via Stripe, PayPal, or merchant processors

refund_period_days.description: Refund policy guarantee window in days (minimum 14 for EU)

siteId.description: Site UUID to attach generated documents to (optional)

uses_google_analytics.description: Whether Google Analytics 4 or Google Tag Manager is utilized

uses_meta_pixel.description: Whether Meta (Facebook) advertising pixels are deployed

name: generate_documents
